description: This file contains implementation of division operations for big numbers (BIGNUMs), including functions for division and modulus. It includes licensing and copyright information and defines functions for division, modulus, and related calculations used in cryptographic Big Number arithmetic.

methods.name: int BN_div(BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs division of big numbers, computing quotient and optionally remainder.

methods.name: int BN_mod(BIGNUM * rem,const BIGNUM * m,const BIGNUM * d,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Computes the modulus (remainder) of big number division.
